query:
UPDATE monitors SET
                    interval_seconds = COALESCE($2, interval_seconds),
                    timeout_seconds  = COALESCE($3, timeout_seconds),
                    active           = COALESCE($4, active),
                    group_id         = CASE WHEN $5 THEN $6 ELSE group_id END,
                    updated_at       = NOW()
                WHERE id = $1
